paper_identity.title: Systematics of low-lying dipole strengths in odd and even Dy and Gd isotopes

cross_mass_significance: Discovers the dramatic quenching and fragmentation of the Scissors Mode in odd-A deformed rare-earth nuclei (155Gd, 157Gd, 161Dy, 163Dy): total observed M1 strength drops by 35-45% compared to even-even cores (156Gd, 162Dy), and fragments into dozens of small peaks due to Pauli blocking of Fermi-surface Nilsson orbits and strong coupling to a 15-fold denser forest of 3-quasiparticle background states.
